title: Pirogue Coastal Canoe Race
tagline: Punch the surf, round the buoy and ride the swell home.
description: The coastal canoe regatta of West Africa. Paddle a painted pirogue with taps on the left and right, keep the crew's rhythm, punch each crest bow-on, brace against the heel and surf the swell back to the beach. Three rival crews, five seas, Time Trial, Two Players and a Watch & Learn coach.
howToPlay: Tap the left or right half of the screen to paddle on that side.
Tap in the bright arc of the ring to keep the crew's beat.
Stroke just before each crest hits, bow straight, to punch through.
Paddle on the low side to brace when the boat heels.
Round the buoy, then make two perfect strokes to catch a swell home.
